declarations.name: AppExtensionSceneConfiguration
declarations.comment:
An object you use to configure an app extension that provides a custom UI.

Use this type to provide the configuration details for an
<doc://com.apple.documentation/documentation/extensionfoundation/appextension> type
when the corresponding app extension provides a custom UI.

members.name: accept
members.comment:

- Parameters:
 - connection: The incoming XPC connection object.

- Returns: A Boolean value that indicates whether the extension accepts the connection.

declarations.name: PrimitiveAppExtensionScene
declarations.comment:
A type you use to deliver the contents of your app-extension-based UI.

When defining an ``AppExtensionScene`` type, provide a `PrimitiveAppExtensionScene`
structure as the body of that type. This type facilitates the delivery of the scene’s
UI views back to the host app for incorporation into the host view controller.
When constructing this type, specify one of the defined scene identifiers that
the host app supports.

For more information about creating scenes for your app extension, see
 <doc://com.apple.documentation/documentation/extensionkit/including-extension-based-ui-in-your-interface>.
